answer.rationale: Do not match the competitor with broad promotional pricing: the recovered discount experiment produced short-term signup and qualified-revenue gains but a 12% 30-day retention decline, making it unsuitable for the stated sustainable-revenue objective. Expand the established-customer referral motion through a standard, controlled rollout; it previously added qualified revenue without measurable retention harm. This will not directly resolve every price-driven SMB churn conversation, so avoid claiming it is a complete churn-defense solution and pair account conversations with non-discount value framing operationally.
